title: Expert’s Recommendations in Product Choices: Information Provision, Conflicts of Interest, and Consumer Protection among U.S. Kidney Disease Patients
authors: Reza Roshangarzadeh; TI Tongil Kim; Shervin Shahrokhi Tehrani
eligible_reason: Structural/two-stage discrete choice model of physician recommendations and dialysis facility choice (USRDS-type patient data), with counterfactuals. No DiD; shipped data are a noised random sample of 8,000 patients.
design_notes: Code/Code/estimation.m, reduced_form_estimation.m (two-stage reduced-form choice likelihood), CF_execution.m.
data_files_note: Masked IDs, random noise in variables, random sample of 8,000 patients.
data_provenance_note: Readme_data: IDs masked, random noise introduced in variables, random sample of 8,000 patients. Moot (no DiD).
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available at screening time (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked); screened from the package README, code, shipped data and the OpenAlex abstract. Title of package README/code matches the paper (no mismatch).
